column3: The canonical carve-out class: the sites are in collections/slab.mojo, inside the Slab's OWN storage. Encapsulating the unsafe partial move inside a primitive is the entire point of the encapsulation rule (primitive-internal). Retiring it needs a Mojo-level move-out-of-slot primitive that Slab can call; there is no caller-side change that removes it.
